We are excited to announce that we have been awarded a grant from Nigeria Youth Futures Fund, @ng_youthfund to implement a Research on Technology, Artificial Intelligence and Civic Engagement in Africa: Issues and Emerging Framework,” in Nigeria between January and March 2026. 

The project will generate practical evidence on how artificial intelligence can be responsibly leveraged to strengthen youth civic participation, improve citizen–government engagement, and enhance accountability, while addressing local realities and structural barriers to participation. 

Through this research, we seek to review existing civic-tech and AI use case studies and develop a localized AI prototype to amplify youth voices and support more inclusive and responsive governance across Africa. We look forward to contributing meaningful insights, innovative tools, and actionable recommendations that advance civic engagement in Nigeria and across Africa
